title: Academy's Genius Swordmaster
altTitles: The Genius Swordsman of the Academy
アカデミーの天才剣士
description: Ronan lived a wasteful life filled with regrets. At the end of his futile life, he is given a second chance and returns to his childhood ten years in the past. Determined to make his new life meaningful for the people who sacrificed themselves for him, Ronan enrolls in the prestigious Phileon Academy and begins his journey to become the strongest swordsman the empire has ever seen.
author: SeoGwando (West Guando) / BluePic Studio
